title: Towed to dealer and replacement repairs
summary: This topic centers on G70 incidents where vehicles were towed to the dealer or service and some cases mention parts being replaced, with limited sentiment clarity in most examples.

negative.summary: The negative review describes a vehicle being towed back to service where a sensor problem was identified.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention towing to the dealer, shutdown or no-start events, a trunk stuck open, and replacement of items such as an electronic trunk closure unit or theater screen without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are classified as undetermined, so sentiment interpretation is limited.
The cluster mixes roadside towing events, dealer handling, and replacement repairs, which may reflect more than one underlying issue.
Examples are brief and often lack outcome details, so they do not support broader conclusions about severity or prevalence.
